LanguageData.LP_HalfOrc.label: half-orc
LanguageData.LP_HalfOrc.description: The mixed offspring of orcs and humans; the bloodline is passed on to children. Green skin, heavy jaws, sturdy bodies, good at melee, strong and ruthless; hot-tempered, slow learners, poor at socializing and not pleasant to look at. Half-orcs have a stubbornness that refuses to fall: when they should go down they can grit their teeth and hold on for half a day; their punches and axe swings sometimes land savage blows.
LanguageData.LP_HalfOrc.descriptionShort: Inheritable mixed race. Strong melee, sturdy, night vision; hot-tempered, slow learners, poor socializers. Once per day grits teeth to stay up instead of being downed; melee sometimes lands heavy blows.
LanguageData.LP_Elf.label: high elf
LanguageData.LP_Elf.description: A tall, beautiful, long-lived race whose bloodline is passed on to children (called "high elves" since 1.57.0; elves in old saves are high elves). Fair skin, golden or silver hair, pointed ears, slender, natural archers, quick learners, gifted in the arts; they sleep little and age only 5% as fast as others after adulthood; strong-minded and hard to sway with psychic effects. Their bodies are rather fragile and take worse injuries, their melee strength is weak, and they disdain heavy labor. Elves enter a meditative "trance" in sleep; psychically gifted elves slowly regain psyfocus while sleeping and wake in a better mood.
LanguageData.LP_Elf.descriptionShort: Inheritable long-lived race. Strong at shooting and art, quick learners, sleep little, age extremely slowly after adulthood, high mind resistance; fragile bodies, weak melee, slow at physical work. Meditate during sleep and wake in a better mood.
LanguageData.LP_Dwarf.label: mountain dwarf
LanguageData.LP_Dwarf.description: A short, stocky mountain race whose bloodline is passed on to children (called "mountain dwarves" since 1.57.0; dwarves in old saves are mountain dwarves). About 80% the size of an ordinary person, all bearded; sturdy, poison-resistant, able to see in the dark, born miners, craftsmen and axe fighters, but slow walkers. Mountain dwarves grow up in iron armor, so apparel slows them only half as much. Dwarves never get addicted to alcohol, have mild hangovers and grow bolder after a few drinks; they are happier living under thick rock roofs in the mountain's belly and mine and work faster there; dwarves never forget a blood debt.
LanguageData.LP_Dwarf.descriptionShort: Inheritable short race. Strong at mining, crafting and melee, sturdy and poison-resistant, night vision, armor training; slow and small; holds grudges. Never addicted to alcohol, happier and more productive inside a mountain.
